rca of the issue: CourierDashboard.jsx line 171 initializes manifest state to a hardcoded array of 3 fake bags: `const [manifest, setManifest] = useState(INITIAL_MANIFEST);` where INITIAL_MANIFEST (lines 45-48) is `[{id:'LND-011',...},{id:'LND-012',...},{id:'LND-013',...}]`. There is no subsequent GET call that would overwrite the manifest with real data, so the mock rows are permanent until the user manually completes pickup for each fake id (impossible — they don't exist in DB). Fix: `useState([])` and either drop the manifest UI entirely or wire it to a real backend query. Root cause is that INITIAL_MANIFEST was left in place when other INITIAL_* mocks were retired in previous iterations.
